pcs.pc_description: determine the work requirements such as type of tasks to be performed (repair, maintenance, etc.), equipment to be maintained by interpreting instruction sheet/job card, maintenance log book/card/sheet and instructions from supervisor
enquire with the user/operator about any problems/unusual conditions noticed on the equipment
obtain and interpret drawings, specifications, manufacturers' manuals, maintenance manual, checklist and other documents needed in the maintenance process
read the maintenance schedule and checklist to identify tools, consumables, spare parts required during the task
follow safety practices during maintenance activities as per organisational SOP
perform basic health check-up of equipment as specified in the maintenance checklist
dismantle the equipment and replace/change the spare parts and consumables as per the schedule

check the systems of the equipment to find out root cause of the problems like improper alignment and force/pressure (e.g. spring pressure, hydraulic or pneumatic pressures), leakage, vibration, thermal (e.g. bearings, friction surfaces), erratic movement (e.g. travel, clearance, levers, links), noise, under- rated performance or any other problem by using a range of diagnostic and testing equipment
deal with equipment malfunction and rectify faults during the breakdown servicing process as appropriate
relate previous reports/records of similar fault conditions

Use of Industry 4.0 Technologies to evaluate the likely risk of running the equipment with the displayed fault, and the effects the fault could have on health and safety, and on the overall process or system
Perform Predictive Maintenance Analysis to assess when the problem is beyond his competence and report the problem to suitably qualified/designated and competent personnel
carry out servicing and maintenance techniques as applicable
clean, change or repair the equipment components as per requirement
dispose off waste materials such as oil, failed parts/aggregates, as per organisation’s policies
assemble back the covers, guards, clamps, insulation etc. of the equipment and prepare it for conducting the trials
conduct a trial run of the equipment at full power/speed/flow and verify that specified parameters are attained with no abnormalities

• run few cycles of equipment and confirm that the component/process outcome is meeting required specifications • Specifications: components to be free from false tool cuts, burrs and sharp edges; dimensional tolerance +/- 0.25mm or +/- 0.010; flatness and squareness 0.05mm per 25mm; angles within +/- 1 degree; screw threads to Medium fit; reamed holes within H8; surface finish 1.6 m; minimum downtime of utilities; levelling
change the maintenance due/status sticker on the equipment
fill the daily, weekly and monthly maintenance/defect sheets as per the format lay down by the organization
record all repairs carried out, time taken and unplanned tasks encountered during the maintenance activities
identify areas of improvements in the various maintenance services and implement the improvement activities agreed upon by the relevant authorities
